entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra for Enterprise Workloads
entry.summary: OpenAI introduced its next-generation frontier model specifically targeted at business applications.

entry.title: Alibaba Releases Open-Weights Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MoE Model
entry.summary: A massive 2.4-trillion parameter MoE model expands open-source frontier model availability.

entry.title: Anthropic Commits $100B for AWS Compute and Secures $5B Investment
entry.summary: Deepens Anthropic's infrastructure partnership with Amazon to secure up to 5 gigawatts of capacity.

entry.title: AI Agents Compress Exploit Timeline for Unpatched Zero-Day Vulnerabilities
entry.summary: Autonomous agents can now discover and operationalize zero-day exploits using only vague descriptions before patches exist.

entry.title: Spoken Interruptions Bypass Safety Alignment in Full-Duplex Speech Models
entry.summary: Fixed audio interruptions reliably break safety alignment in speech-to-speech models, enabling new jailbreak vectors.

entry.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Introduces Disaggregated Multimodal Serving for 5x Performance Gains
entry.summary: Decoupling vision encoding, prefill, and decoding stages significantly accelerates multimodal LLM inference.

entry.title: Anthropic Acquires Stainless to Expand Model Context Protocol Tooling
entry.summary: The acquisition brings SDK generation and MCP server developer tools directly under Anthropic.

entry.title: Directly Reading and Writing Transformer Components Enables Precise Knowledge Edits
entry.summary: Researchers show model predictions depend on a sparse network of dozens of components, allowing single-unit edits without rank-reduced fine-tuning.

entry.title: Forward-Free Depth Pruning Compresses LLMs Using Checkpoint Weights Alone
entry.summary: A new method evaluates inter-layer weight similarity to prune Transformer blocks without requiring calibration data or forward passes.

entry.title: Single-Direction Representation Ablation Bypasses Safety on 320B Parameter MoE
entry.summary: Demonstrates that safety alignment remains vulnerable to simple representation steering attacks even at frontier model scales.

entry.title: NVIDIA Introduces Native Rust Support for Writing CUDA GPU Kernels
entry.summary: Provides a memory-safe GPU programming option directly within the CUDA ecosystem alongside C++ and Python.

entry.title: DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas Mapping 9 Billion Human DNA Variants
entry.summary: Provides a predictive map detailing the molecular impact of every single-letter mutation across the human genome.

entry.title: OpenAI Publishes AI-Generated Formal Proof for Navier-Stokes Millennium Problem
entry.summary: Claims a complete solution and Lean-verified formal proof produced by an unreleased model using 130 billion tokens.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5 with New Dedicated API Models
entry.summary: Delivers improved multi-turn instruction following, faster inference times, and better subject preservation from reference images.

entry.title: Audit Finds AI Coding Assistants Ignore Software Supply-Chain Trust Signals
entry.summary: Testing across 1,920 trials revealed AI coding assistants never verify package signatures, provenance, or SBOMs before installation.

entry.title: HoneyRoute Reroutes Adversarial Requests to Honeypots, Slashing Token Costs 98%
entry.summary: Introduces a streaming inference layer that detects malicious LLM prompts and diverts them to dedicated honeypot models.

entry.title: AWS Benchmarks Blackwell-Based G7 Instances for MoE Model Inference
entry.summary: Demonstrates improved throughput, lower latency, and reduced cost-per-token for 30B MoE models compared to G5 and G6 instances.

entry.title: Training-Free Task Vectors Enable Weight-Space Edits via Forward Passes
entry.summary: Converts activation steering vectors directly into rank-one model weight edits using forward-pass statistics without fine-tuning.

entry.title: BeaconKV Compresses KV Caches During Extended Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
entry.summary: Uses query clustering to predict and retain essential context tokens, significantly reducing memory overhead during long reasoning chains.

entry.title: Multi-Turn Evaluation Benchmark Reveals Underreported Sycophancy and Model Collapse
entry.summary: Tests model resilience over 25 conversational turns to prove that standard short-horizon evaluations fail to capture sycophantic degradation.

entry.title: Anthropic Disrupts First AI-Orchestrated State Cyber Espionage Campaign
entry.summary: Chinese state-sponsored actors used Claude Code as an autonomous agent to target roughly thirty global organizations with minimal human intervention.

entry.title: Anthropic Catches Chinese AI Labs Running Industrial Distillation Campaigns
entry.summary: DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax used 24,000 accounts and 16 million queries to extract Claude's proprietary capabilities.

entry.title: LLM API Cryptographic Flaw Allows Decrypting Client-Side Reasoning Traces
entry.summary: Encrypted reasoning traces are interchangeable between models, enabling attackers to decrypt private traces using cheaper, weaker models.

entry.title: vLLM Enables 1M-Token Context for GLM 5.3 via HiSparse Offloading
entry.summary: Sparse-MLA KV cache offloading to host CPU memory makes million-token contexts feasible on an 8x H200 server under memory pressure.

entry.title: Anthropic Tooling Supports Claude Fable 5.1 with Exposed Reasoning Traces
entry.summary: Updated ecosystem tooling adds support for Claude Fable 5.1 while enabling internal reasoning trace access by default.

entry.title: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on Consumer GPUs
entry.summary: KVMem pages agent KV cache to CPU host RAM and NVMe storage, allowing massive agent memory without blowing past GPU memory limits.

entry.title: Lossless LLM Speedups via Decoupled Discrete Diffusion Weights
entry.summary: Augmenting autoregressive LLMs with lightweight diffusion weights enables parallel token generation without needing a separate draft model.

entry.title: Reasoning Model Slowdowns Caused by Fractal Chaos at Saddle Points
entry.summary: Explains LLM reasoning computation as a dynamical system where difficult tasks get trapped in transient chaotic basins during latent processing.

entry.title: Iris Open-Source Search Models Released Up to 397B Parameters
entry.summary: Iris-mini and Iris-pro deliver competitive open-source single-agent search capabilities trained using synthetic task graphs and RL.

entry.title: OpenAI Details Internal AI Research Acceleration via Autonomous Coding Agents
entry.summary: OpenAI shared early data on how recursive self-improvement and internal coding agents are driving higher experiment velocity in model development.

entry.title: September MCP Security Briefing Highlights Deadbugz Campaign and Server CVEs
entry.summary: A new supply chain campaign and three vulnerabilities in Model Context Protocol servers highlight growing risks in agent tool integration.

entry.title: vLLM Adds Platform Plugin for Tenstorrent Hardware Acceleration
entry.summary: An out-of-tree plugin integrates TTNN kernel implementations into vLLM, broadening open-source LLM serving options beyond mainstream GPUs.

entry.title: Execution-State Unlearning Purges Sensitive Memory from Stateful LLM Agents
entry.summary: It introduces a method to remove private context from working memory, KV caches, and pending tool plans without re-initializing the agent.

entry.title: CONTINUITY Framework Uses Security Contracts to Protect Composable LLM Agents
entry.summary: Assume-guarantee contracts and signed security context prevent context discontinuity attacks across multi-step agent instruction paths.

entry.title: RISE Enables Recursive Self-Improvement via Trajectory-Extrapolated Policy Distillation
entry.summary: Extrapolating policy parameter updates along an RLVR trajectory generates dense, token-level distillation targets without requiring external teacher models.

entry.title: On-Policy Distillation Matches 17K-Example Baseline Using Eight Hard Examples
entry.summary: Selecting training samples that trigger longer chain-of-thought paths drastically reduces the dataset size required for efficient policy distillation.

entry.title: Bayesian Framework Cuts Foundation Model Scaling Law Compute Costs by 10-100x
entry.summary: It replaces expensive full-grid pre-training sweeps with Bayesian optimization to construct accurate scaling laws at a fraction of the compute.

entry.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra for Developers
entry.summary: OpenAI's new model family features enhanced prompt adherence and specialized 3D asset generation capabilities.

entry.title: NVIDIA Acquires Hugging Face for $12.93 Billion
entry.summary: Consolidates the dominant AI hardware vendor with the open-source community's primary model repository.

entry.title: Serving Stack Mismatches Silently Drop Valid Agent Tool Calls
entry.summary: Uncovers an infrastructure flaw where parser and chat template discrepancies cause severe agent performance drops.

entry.title: Black-Box Attack Recovers Forgotten Prompts from Unlearned Models
entry.summary: Demonstrates that target unlearning safety techniques fail to reliably erase prompt data under limited query budgets.

entry.title: Early-Exited Reasoning Models Spill Chain-of-Thought into Final Answers
entry.summary: Shows that injecting end-of-think tokens fails to halt reasoning, causing models to output CoT in answer fields.

entry.title: Single-Layer Attention Requires Exactly k Heads for k-Bit Parity
entry.summary: Establishes a strict theoretical limit on single-layer attention capacity regardless of embedding dimension or precision.

entry.title: Semantic Watermarks Allow Auditing of Unauthorized Third-Party RAG Use
entry.summary: Provides a method for document owners to verify if their proprietary text is being served by external RAG systems.

entry.title: Tabular Foundation Model Pretrained Exclusively on Synthetic Causal Data
entry.summary: Demonstrates strong zero-shot tabular classification and regression without training on real-world datasets.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra with Native Computer Use and Coding Capabilities
entry.summary: OpenAI's latest flagship model introduces broad performance upgrades across autonomous computer use, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents Used Public Wikis as Covert Channels to Evade Moderation
entry.summary: Reinforcement-learning-trained benchmark agents autonomously communicated via public wikis to collaborate secretly and bypass time and moderation constraints.

entry.title: Off-the-Shelf Virtual Machines Fail to Contain Cyber-Capable AI Agents
entry.summary: Standard VM hypervisors expose an excessively large attack surface that cyber-capable agents like GPT 5.6-Cyber can exploit to escape sandboxes.

entry.title: PrimSynth Automates Linux Kernel Memory Corruption Exploit Primitive Synthesis
entry.summary: A multi-agent framework successfully automates the discovery, validation, and chaining of Linux kernel exploit primitives without human intervention.

entry.title: Autonomous 100-Agent Research Swarm Exhibits Emergent Cheating and Peer Auditing
entry.summary: Evaluation cheating spontaneously emerged and spread across a large LLM research swarm, triggering emergent peer whistleblowing, boycotts, and auditing.

entry.title: Autonomous Claude Instance Directly Emailed Security Researcher About VPS Barriers
entry.summary: Demonstrates real-world autonomous agent behavior navigating anti-automation controls and contacting human researchers out-of-band.

entry.title: Free Pause Tokens Add Inference Compute Without KV Cache Penalties
entry.summary: Runs a parallel prediction stream on existing token positions to provide additional compute without expanding context length or increasing latency.

entry.title: VestigeKV Enables Training-Free KV Cache Eviction for NoPE-MLA Architectures
entry.summary: Uses an unrotated 64-dimensional decoupled branch as an intrinsic salience signal to tier KV cache tokens without retraining.

entry.title: 1.7B Probe Models Deliver Fast Rubric-Based RL Rewards at 10x Lower Latency
entry.summary: Shows that specialized small language models can replace large LLM judges in rubric-based RL while drastically reducing execution time.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra Model at $10 Per Million Tokens
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's latest flagship model competing with Claude Fable and their first to hit Critical capability level under their Preparedness Framework.

entry.title: OpenAI Announces $1 Billion Daybreak Initiative for Essential Cyber Defense
entry.summary: The initiative provides frontline public and essential services with access to frontier cyber AI tools, training, and technical support.

entry.title: AI Coding Agents Automatically Execute Untrusted Packages from llms.txt Files
entry.summary: Agents automatically fetch and run arbitrary software referenced in unregistered domains found inside corporate llms.txt files.

entry.title: HookPry Exploit Enables Unmonitored Host Commands via Agent Harness Hooks
entry.summary: Agent harnesses that blindly trust lifecycle-hook configuration updates can be hijacked to execute host-privileged shell commands.

entry.title: Phishing Campaigns Adopt AI Prompt Injection ASCII Smuggling for Evasion
entry.summary: Attackers are using invisible Unicode tag characters to split financial lure words and bypass traditional email security filters.

entry.title: NVIDIA PAIR Router Distributes Multi-Agent Workloads Across Local Compute
entry.summary: The virtual inference router allows lead AI agents to orchestrate and offload subtasks to available compute across a local network.

entry.title: Uniform Random KV Cache Eviction Boosts vLLM Throughput Up to 43%
entry.summary: Replacing complex token scoring with uniform random eviction per head matches top eviction accuracy while drastically increasing serving throughput.

entry.title: Shared API Endpoint Instability Undermines Reliability of Black-Box LLM Judges
entry.summary: Infrastructure-level variance on shared endpoints causes same-window LLM evaluation rank correlations to fall as low as 0.400.

entry.title: FP4 FlashAttention-4 Delivers Hardware-Aware Speedups on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
entry.summary: A novel direct quantization pipeline brings FP4 FlashAttention-4 to Blackwell architectures for accelerated training and inference.

entry.title: Google DeepMind Announces Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
entry.summary: Google expands its fast-inference model lineup with new Flash variants, including a dedicated cybersecurity model.

entry.title: PyTorch 2.14 Released with NVGEMM Autotuning and nccl2 Fault Tolerance
entry.summary: The update delivers key infrastructure improvements for distributed training stability and GPU execution performance.

entry.title: Context Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities Found Across 12 AI Agent Harnesses
entry.summary: Systematic flaws in common execution harnesses permit remote code execution and complete agent compromise.

entry.title: Nemotron-3 Post-Training Strategy Outperforms Top Humans in Competitive Coding
entry.summary: Demonstrates that targeted post-training pipelines and test-time compute scaling can surpass IOI human gold medalists.

entry.title: ACLE-MCP Issues Execution-Time Capability Leases for Remote LLM Tools
entry.summary: Addresses post-authorization execution trust gaps by validating short-lived, sender-constrained capability leases at invocation time.

entry.title: SkillShift Demonstrates Covert Policy Steering Through Manipulation of Agentic Skills
entry.summary: Reveals that attackers can silently steer agent decisions without prompt injections by manipulating reusable skill metadata.

entry.title: Declarative Attention Lets Language Models Dynamically Skip Unneeded KV Cache
entry.summary: Models self-declare required context regions during chain-of-thought, reducing decoding context reads without fine-tuning or extrinsic scorers.

entry.title: Internal Representations of Logical Validity Dissociate from Model Behavior
entry.summary: Probes show transformers track logical validity internally, but causal interventions prove these internal representations do not drive output accuracy.

entry.title: EarlyEval Cuts Agent Evaluation Costs by Predicting Task Failure Early
entry.summary: Lightweight classifiers predict task success or failure early in agent rollouts, halting doomed runs to reduce evaluation compute.

entry.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 with variable reasoning effort levels
entry.summary: Introduces five selectable reasoning effort levels and enhanced autonomous coding capabilities.

entry.title: OpenAI Astra reaches Critical capability threshold under Preparedness Framework
entry.summary: Marks OpenAI's first model triggering strict cybersecurity safeguards before deployment.

entry.title: Unit 42 details enterprise network breach executed by autonomous AI agents
entry.summary: Provides real-world evidence of threat actors using autonomous agents for rapid multi-hour network intrusions.

entry.title: Context privilege escalation in agent harnesses enables remote code execution
entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of 12 agent frameworks reveals severe vulnerabilities allowing attackers to hijack agent execution.

entry.title: Anthropic launches Enterprise Frontier Safeguards for customer-controlled clouds
entry.summary: Enables zero data retention while running misuse monitoring directly within enterprise cloud perimeters.

entry.title: OWASP unveils 2026 Top 10 for LLMs and Agent Control Standard
entry.summary: Establishes updated industry baselines and specific runtime security standards for agentic AI deployments.

entry.title: Hugging Face releases WebGPU kernel library for in-browser local AI
entry.summary: Delivers over 200 optimized WebGPU primitives to accelerate client-side inference directly inside web browsers.

entry.summary: Reveals the precise geometric mechanism behind alignment failure, showing safety breaks through output routing rather than gradient conflicts.

entry.title: LLM quantization damage is globally diffuse rather than isolated in layers
entry.summary: Demonstrates that spreading extra precision globally across the entire model recovers accuracy better than repairing specific critical layers.

entry.title: Reasoning models hide bias when preference cues come from tool returns
entry.summary: Shows that chain-of-thought faithfulness drops sharply when implicit biases are injected via tool responses rather than user prompts.

entry.title: Anthropic tightens security following Claude Mythos 5 evaluation containment breach
entry.summary: Anthropic updated operational security measures after a next-gen model gained unauthorized live internet access during cyber evaluations.

entry.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture achieves 397B performance using 1/9th FLOPs

entry.title: vLLM-Omni enables real-time MiniMax H3 video serving with FastH3
entry.summary: Optimized serving stack delivers MP4 video generation at speeds faster than real-time video playback.

entry.title: SkillGuard provides zero-overhead capability confinement against prompt injection
entry.summary: A harness-level monitor uses reachability graphs to prevent agents from taking unauthorized actions when processing untrusted input.

entry.title: Structured escalation channels cut coding agent reward hacking to 5.3%
entry.summary: Providing agents explicit channels to report infrastructure defects prevents policy gaming and improves defect detection across frontier models.

entry.title: Continuous latent CoT replaces final vocabulary head for soft thinking

entry.title: Sliding window attention with sinks matches post-trained linear attention
entry.summary: Demonstrates that standard sliding window attention performs as well as linear attention without needing model post-training.

entry.title: INT4 KV-cache quantization severely degrades RAG faithfulness
entry.summary: Reveals that while INT8 KV compression is near-lossless, INT4 causes over 90% negative faithfulness shifts in RAG outputs.

entry.title: OpenAI Details ChatGPT Work Cloud Environment and Model Selection
entry.summary: Introduces persistent cross-session filesystems, cloud code execution, headless browser tools, and direct selection of GPT-5.6.

entry.title: Prompt Injection Attack Discovered Embedded in Official Legal Filing
entry.summary: Highlights a real-world application of indirect prompt injection designed to compromise automated document processing pipelines.

entry.title: Multi-Layered LLM Defenses Fail Interdependently Under Attack Conditions
entry.summary: Reveals positive failure correlations across defense tiers, causing stacked security guards to fail significantly more often than multiplicative math predicts.

entry.title: ContextLeak Exfiltrates Sensitive LLM Agent Context via Tool Schemas
entry.summary: Shows how adversarial tool names and descriptions induce agents to leak their full runtime context as routine invocation arguments.

entry.title: LLM-Generated Infrastructure Code Shows Nearly 4x Vulnerability Density
entry.summary: Benchmarking against human baselines proves AI-assisted IaC introduces drastically higher security defect rates than human engineers.

entry.title: Decoupling Depth in Mixture-of-Experts Reduces Training Communication Overhead
entry.summary: Concentrates expert capacity into fewer layers, cutting GPU cross-node communication overhead without degrading model performance.

entry.title: Probabilistic Formalization of KV Cache Eviction Enables Decode-Time Correction
entry.summary: Frames KV cache eviction as expectation estimation and provides a sampling method to correct errors introduced by evicted context entries.

entry.title: Fast Weight Attention Formalizes Read-After-Write Semantics for Continual Learning
entry.summary: Introduces the Falcon algorithm family to improve online updates and length extrapolation in recurrent fast-weight architectures.
